en: Got the job? Congratulations! But now there's a whole new city to figure out. A place to stay, food, and the way to the office. All on your own.
Meet Settlr. New job. New city. Everything sorted. Starting in Pune.
Just answer a few questions: which city, where your office is, when you're moving, and your monthly budget.
Settlr shows PGs and flats near your office, tiffin services, and commute options, with distance and cost. Filter them, save them, and compare them.
Your plan keeps every cost separate: monthly, one-time, and deposits. If your PG includes meals, you never pay for a tiffin twice.
A checklist built around your move date, and your whole move on one dashboard.
Settlr. Your new job. Your new city. Everything sorted.
